method_note: SmallSat 2026 (40th Small Satellite Conference, Salt Lake City, 23-26 Aug 2026). Counted the oral technical sessions in the official USU Digital Commons proceedings for 2026 that list at least one paper: 19 sessions (11 main 'E' sessions, 5 Research & Academia sessions and 4 Flash Talk sessions) with 116 papers. 'Future Directions' and Flash Talks 4 list no papers and were excluded, as were the keynote and 4 poster sessions (151 posters). Every session is about small satellites, so each was tagged 'smallsat'. Sessions whose papers share a clear sub-theme also got a second keyword, chosen from the session title and its paper titles and split 50/50: communications for Advanced Technologies 1 and 3 and Flash 1, AI/ML for Advanced Technologies 2 and R&A 1, propulsion for Launch & Propulsion, and GNC for R&A Advanced Technologies 2 and Flash 3. Mission-review sessions (Year in Review, Next on the Pad, their R&A versions, Flash 2 and Flash 5) are 'smallsat' only. Caveats: the session names are generic, so the second keyword reflects the dominant paper theme and mixed sessions are simplified. Dropped (<0.02): none; the kept raw session fractions summed to 1 and were renormalized to sum to 1 (raw counts are in each evidence string). In 'tracks', each entry is one program session and 'papers' is the number of entries listed. deployable-structures added 2026-10-16: no oral session is themed on deployables, so paper titles in the 19 counted sessions were screened and each deployable-structure paper (deployable antennas/reflectors/telescope, inflatable reflector, membrane, solar/light sails, HDRM hinge) counted as 1/n of its session: 9 papers = 1/6+1/7+1/6+2/8+1/4+2/8+1/7 = 1.369 session-equivalents, weight 1.369/19 = 0.072, subtracted from the generic 'smallsat' tag (second-keyword halves left unchanged), so the sum stays 1. Poster sessions remain excluded (e.g. a compact hold-down and release system and a deployable parabolic reflector poster are not counted); ChipSat deployers were not counted as deployable structures.
